builders.angle: LITERAL -- work BRIEF-r47's fix list 1 to 3 in order and exactly as written, one wing at a time, the Kennels FIRST (the round's fight). Never fewer objects, never a smoother or tidier surface; keep every change inside your four wings.

THE HERO PROP FIRST -- in each wing find the ONE object a player's eye lands on (the Kennels' doghouses, the Hedge's yew walls, the Attic's trunks, the Bathhouse's tubs) and redraw it as an inked object with real material and a contact shadow before anything else; then dress the near floor around it; then the darks.

FILL THE NEAR FLOOR -- both judges name empty or black near floors in these wings. Bring objects forward into a lit pool in every room (kennels and a trough, a stool and towels, leaf drifts and a fallen urn, a hatbox and a rolled rug), each with a contact shadow, then redraw the back props in that light and keep every dark dark.
